summary: Pure test pins the exact chained bind-key line; real-tmux test proves via list-keys that copy-mode/select-word/copy-pipe-and-cancel land on ONE binding. Empirically reproduced the historical bug myself: bare CLI ';' only binds 'copy-mode -M' (the rest fire immediately and error), while the config-file '\;' form used here binds all three together — confirming this test suite would catch a regression.
